segments.ja472:1.1: Nādaṭṭhā [nādiṭṭhā (ka. sī. syā. ka.)] parato dosaṃ, aṇuṃ thūlāni sabbaso;
segments.ja472:2.1: Yo ca appaṭivekkhitvā, daṇḍaṃ kubbati khattiyo;
segments.ja472:3.1: Adaṇḍiyaṃ daṇḍayati [daṇḍiyati (syā. pī.)], daṇḍiyañca adaṇḍiyaṃ [adaṇḍiya (niyya), na daṇḍaye (?)];
segments.ja472:3.3: Andhova visamaṃ maggaṃ, na jānāti samāsamaṃ.
segments.ja472:4.1: Yo ca etāni ṭhānāni, aṇuṃ thūlāni sabbaso;
segments.ja472:5.3: Attaṃ mahante [mahatte (syā. ka.)] ṭhapetuṃ [ṭhāpetuṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], tasmā ubhayamācare.
segments.ja472:6.1: Paribhūto mudu hoti, atitikkho ca veravā;
segments.ja472:7.1: Bahumpi ratto bhāseyya, duṭṭhopi bahu bhāsati;
segments.ja472:8.1: Sabbova [sabbo ca (ka. sī. pī.)] loko ekato [ekanto (sī. pī.)], itthī ca ayamekikā;
segments.ja472:8.3: Tenāhaṃ paṭipajjissaṃ, gacchatha pakkhipatheva [pakkhipetha (syā. aṭṭha.)] taṃ.
segments.ja472:9.1: Anekatāle narake, gambhīre ca suduttare [gambhīre suduruttare (pī. ka.)];
segments.ja472:9.3: Pātito giriduggasmiṃ, kena tvaṃ tattha nāmari.
segments.ja472:10.3: Paccaggahi maṃ bhogehi, tenāhaṃ tattha nāmariṃ.
segments.ja472:11.1: Ehi taṃ paṭinessāmi, rājaputta sakaṃ gharaṃ;
segments.ja472:11.3: Rajjaṃ kārehi [kāresi (sī.)] bhaddante, kiṃ araññe karissasi.
segments.ja472:12.3: Uddharitvā sukhī assa, evaṃ [sukhaṃ (pī. ka.)] passāmi attanaṃ [attani (pī. ka.), attanā (syā.), evaṃ ahampi puna sotthibhāvappattaṃ gilitabaḷisaṃ purisamiva attānaṃ passāmīti (aṭṭha. saṃvaṇṇanā)].
segments.ja472:13.1: Kiṃ nu tvaṃ baḷisaṃ brūsi, kiṃ tvaṃ brūsi salohitaṃ;
segments.ja472:13.3: Kiṃ nu tvaṃ ubbhataṃ brūsi, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
segments.ja472:14.3: Cattāhaṃ ubbhataṃ brūmi, evaṃ jānāhi khattiya.
segments.ja472:15.1: Ciñcāmāṇavikā mātā, devadatto ca me pitā;
segments.ja472:15.3: Ānando paṇḍito nāgo, sāriputto ca devatā;
segments.ja472:15.5: Rājaputto ahaṃ āsiṃ [ahaṃ tadā rājaputto (sī. syā. pī.)], evaṃ dhāretha jātakanti.
